title: EC2 Outbound Internet Access Fails
symptom: Instance cannot run `yum update` or reach external APIs (curl https://aws.amazon.com hangs).
initial_observations: Inbound SSH works, but outbound HTTP/HTTPS times out.
DNS queries may fail or hang.

possible_causes.cause: Security Group outbound rules deleted or restricted
possible_causes.evidence_needed: describe-security-groups showing no egress rule for 0.0.0.0/0.
possible_causes.remediation: Add egress rule allowing all traffic (or TCP 80/443) to 0.0.0.0/0.

possible_causes.cause: Subnet route table has no route to IGW or NAT Gateway
possible_causes.remediation: Add 0.0.0.0/0 route to Internet Gateway (if public) or NAT Gateway (if private).

investigation_steps.title: Check Subnet Route Table
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Default route pointing to igw or nat.

verification: Run `curl -I https://aws.amazon.com` inside instance and verify 200/301 status.
prevention: Do not remove default allow-all egress rule from Security Groups unless egress proxy is deployed.
